title: Return Premium Terms Table for Excess Flood Policies
content:
How much premium an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy returns when the insured cancels turns on four tier terms: the share of the term premium fully earned once the policy is bound, the method of return, whether a paid claim in the term makes the premium fully earned, and whether the surplus lines tax and stamping fee follow the returned premium.

| Tier | Excess Flood 250K | Excess Flood 500K | Excess Flood 1M | Excess Flood 2M | Excess Flood 3M | Excess Flood 5M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Share of the term premium that is fully earned once the policy is bound, whatever the cancellation date (percent) | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| Method for returning premium on an insured's cancellation | pro rata with minimum earned | pro rata with minimum earned | pro rata with minimum earned | pro rata with minimum earned | pro rata with minimum earned | pro rata with minimum earned |
| Whether the term premium is fully earned when a claim in the term has been paid | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Whether surplus lines tax and stamping fee are returned in proportion to returned premium | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
